.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r7/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests (scoring.toml, test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, five judge.toml headers)
evidence: scoring.toml (task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11) has [gates] render=0.0 constraints=0.0, [weights] functional=0.6 polish=0.2 visual=0.2 (sum 1.0), [floors] functional=0.05; byte-identical to template (diff -q same). Dimension dirs exist exactly: tests/gates/{constraints,render}, tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}. All five judge.toml parse with tomllib; the [judge]/mcp/[scoring] header (everything before the first [[criterion]]) is byte-identical to the frozen template for each of the five files. Each [judge] has judge="claude-code", mode="batched", isolated=false, prompt_template="prompt.md"; no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight keys. Every file declares [[judge.mcp_servers]] name="playwright" command="playwright-mcp" args [--headless,--isolated,--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium,--no-sandbox] (lines 8-12). Only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 declares name="verifier" command="/usr/local/bin/python3" args=["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py","$APP_RESTART_HELPER"], and test.sh:193 does export APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh" after heredoc+sed substitution and chmod 755 (test.sh:185-191), before run_suite (test.sh:204-227). Aggregation: gates all_pass, scored weighted_mean. Criteria: render 1 binary (hro_gate_render), constraints 1 binary (hro_gate_shared) -> gates binary-only; functional 43 binary, weights 0.5-2.5 (sum 58.5); polish 5 binary (sum 12); visual 5 likert points=5 weight 1.2 each with 1..5 anchors in descriptions. Ids unique within each file, all weights >0, no empty descriptions. Prompts resolve: each prompt.md exists, contains {criteria} and {app_context} and no other placeholder; test.sh:196-201 substitutes app_context.md (which has ## Application/## Accounts/## Key screens) into /tests/*/*/prompt.md, covering gates/* and scored/*. Every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 with Playwright and forbids shell; only functional prompt references restart_app (prompt.md:1 and :51, single use at end of protocol D, tied to criterion hro_restart). Budgets nest: gate judges 600+600=1200<1500 gates budget; scored judges 9000+900+900=10800<11100 (run with --max-concurrent-agent 1); 1500+11100=12600<13200 verifier timeout_sec (task.toml:27). test.sh, score.py, restart_mcp.py identical to template, so score.py sits at tests/tools and resolves ../scoring.toml. Adversarial tries: (a) a broken app passing via wiring - not possible, gates are all_pass binary and score.py (shared) exits 1 on gate failure; restart is only callable through the single-use verifier tool, not from polish/visual/gates. (b) A conforming app failing via wiring - none found: no stray placeholders, the restart variable is exported before both suites, no dimension lacks the browser server. Limitation: this is a static/source structural check; raw-evidence-index.json states full configured grading is absent, so RewardKit's actual loading of these five configs in this candidate is NOT EXERCISED, but every element is template-identical wiring and statically verifiable, so no defect remains for this row. Private check-rubric-schema.py / check-scoring-policy.py were not executed (manual application only).
